item.title: Digitalization-Greenization Synergy in Emerging Markets
item.content:encoded:
Haijie Wang, Zhengzhou University

Yanchao Feng, Zhengzhou University

Emerging markets are experiencing structural transformation through the integration of digital technologies with green energy systems, creating opportunities for economic growth and sustainability. This digitalization-greenization synergy aims to enhance efficiency and resilience, yet emerging markets face significant obstacles including regulatory gaps, financial limitations, and unequal access to digital and energy infrastructure.

The special issue seeks research on how this digital-green transition influences macroeconomic dynamics, financial systems, investment patterns, and trade in emerging economies. Theoretical and empirical studies examining inclusive growth, green finance, trade competitiveness, and policy design are particularly welcome, with focus on the economic and financial dimensions of this dual transformation.

Appel publié par Emerging Markets Finance and Trade. Voir l'appel sur le site de l'éditeur. Fiche de l'appel sur kerostig.

  • Carbon Markets and Digital Platforms
  • Energy-Digital Infrastructure Finance

  • Digital Electricity Pricing Mechanisms
  • Renewables, Data, and Capital Flows
  • Digitalization and Energy Subsidies
  • Climate Tech and FDI Flows
  • Socioeconomic Impacts of Energy Transition in Emerging Markets
